liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (1 review): Deal features an otherworldly run by Jerry after the second verse [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-17.dsbd.miller.32486.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 2.5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd92-06-17.schoeps.wier.4673.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 3.77/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer requests a better copy of the audience recording; Jam track overlaps with previous Drums track by thirty seconds; Recording quality is poor, missing summer 1992 soundboards [8][10][11][15]
- **gd1992-06-17.nak300.baker-keo.sirmick.110948.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 138 min [3]. Said about its sound: Small tape degradation during Touch Of Grey; tape flip crossfaded after Jack-A-Roe [3]
- **gd1992-06-17.nak300.baker-keo.sirmick.110947.sbeok.flac24**: audience recording; 18 songs; 138 min [4]. Said about its sound: Small tape degradation during Touch Of Grey; tape flip crossfaded after Jack-A-Roe [4]
- **gd1992-06-17.134987.Nak300CP4.Fitzy.Keo.Flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 134 min [5]. Said about its sound: Missing bits of music from tape flips noted in the recording [5]

## Around the show

- Listener drove from Raleigh to Jersey, stranded, returned to Charlotte for this show [7]
- Listener attended at age thirteen, their first and only Dead show [9]
- Attendee used white fluff blotter and enjoyed seeing Black Peter [13]
- Cops and helicopter present in parking lot; attendee found fluff from a dog owner [17]
- Listener was heavily intoxicated during the show, glad to hear it later [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-17.dsbd.miller.32486.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Paul Scotton; source: SBD -> Dat -> CD [1]
- **gd92-06-17.schoeps.wier.4673.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charles Wier; source: Audience Recording [2]. Also: Listener used AKG 451s into D-10 for the second set; Transfer by Charles Wier from Paul Bottiglio's CDs, CMC-31 to SHN [2][14]
- **gd1992-06-17.nak300.baker-keo.sirmick.110948.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo and SirMick; source: Audience Recording > Nakamichi CM300 with CP4 caps > Sony D6 > MAC (1 x Maxell MX-S100 + 1 x MX-S90) [3]
- **gd1992-06-17.nak300.baker-keo.sirmick.110947.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo and SirMick; source: Audience Recording > Nakamichi CM300 with CP4 caps > Sony D6 > MAC (1 x Maxell MX-S100 + 1 x MX-S90) [4]
- **gd1992-06-17.134987.Nak300CP4.Fitzy.Keo.Flac2496**: taped by Fitzy; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Fitzy, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes: Set 1 Maxell MX-S 90, Set 2 Maxell MX-S 100; Transfer… [5]. Also: Fitzy recorded and shared the source for this show [5]
